Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[On The Payroll Of The Trade Federation]]: "The Fat Boy in Politics", a cartoon by Charles Lewis Bartholomew ("Bart") in ''The Minneapolis Journal'' of Friday, 5 April 1907. A fat man in a top hat holds out a bowl of "$alt" to both the Democratic donkey ("Democracy") and the Republican elephant ("G.O.P."); the caption reads "He would ride either party or both into power if he succeeds in getting his halter on them."

Source: [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Fat_Boy_In_Politics_-_DPLA_-_869b9543e1af8c6af5052e2d72ecf880.jpg The Fat Boy In Politics - DPLA - 869b9543e1af8c6af5052e2d72ecf880.jpg], Wikimedia Commons, from Hennepin County Library through the Digital Public Library of America.
